title: React Router and Navigation
description: Learn how to create multi-page React applications with routing and navigation using React Router v6.

lessons.title: Introduction to React Router
lessons.content: React Router enables navigation between different components, simulating multi-page apps within a single-page application.

lessons.title: Installing and Setting Up React Router
lessons.content:
```bash
npm install react-router-dom@6
```
Basic setup with BrowserRouter wrapping your app.

lessons.title: Defining Routes
Using Link and NavLink for Navigation
Route Parameters and Dynamic Routing
Nested Routes
lessons.content:
```jsx
<Route path="dashboard" element={<Dashboard />}> 
  <Route path="profile" element={<Profile />} />
  <Route path="settings" element={<Settings />} />
</Route>
```

lessons.title: Redirecting and Navigating Programmatically
Navigation Guards and Prompting Before Leave
lessons.content: React Router v6 doesn’t have built-in navigation guards but you can use custom hooks or libraries to prompt users before navigating away.

lessons.title: Summary and Best Practices
lessons.content:
- Use BrowserRouter for web apps
- Define clear route hierarchy
- Use NavLink for active styling
- Handle unknown routes gracefully
- Avoid excessive nesting for readability
